evals.prompt: Using my signed-in browser extension, inspect the three Cloudflare rules in Outlook web. There are 49 rules. Tell me their conditions and whether any are duplicates. Do not change rules.
evals.expected_output: A compact comparison based on expanded configurations, with name-only search limits acknowledged and no saved mutations.
expectations: Uses observed menuitem rows rather than guessed DOM listitems
Scopes repeated Expand rule controls to an identified row
Reads sibling summaries without an ambiguous outer tabpanel locator
Does not claim search by name searches condition values
Does not save, toggle, reorder, delete, or run any rule

evals.prompt: Create an Outlook web rule to delete future mail from alerts@example.com whose subject contains Weekly digest. Use my signed-in browser extension.
evals.expected_output: An authorized ordinary Delete rule with committed exact sender and subject chips in two AND rows, verified after save without processing existing mail.
expectations: Checks likely existing rules before creation
Chooses From and Subject includes in separate condition rows
Commits sender and full subject phrase with Enter and verifies chips
Chooses exact Delete option, not Permanent delete
Leaves Run rule now unchecked and verifies saved configuration

evals.prompt: Two Outlook rules have the same name. Edit the one from alerts@example.com with subject Weekly digest to use Monthly digest. Keep its exception, enabled state, order, and stop-processing setting. Do not run it now.
evals.expected_output: The matching configuration is disambiguated; old subject chip is replaced, not appended, and unrelated settings and the other rule are preserved.
expectations: Disambiguates same-name rules using current position and configuration
Removes the old subject chip before committing Monthly digest
Preserves exception, enabled state, order, and stop-processing
Leaves Run rule now off and verifies the edited rule
